gist.summary: Added @patbing’s Trolley Match to the games catalog and README’s recent-apps list. The web game asks players to choose first in five trolley dilemmas, then compare their answers with live Jev decisions; it also offers an order-swap experiment and session-only Bring Your Own Pollen sign-in. Tiny Fighter Arena rotated off the README’s recent-apps list; this PR does not remove it from the catalog.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden, Polli wears a tiny conductor’s cap and studies five miniature trolley-track junctions beside a warm CRT showing Jev’s choices and two swapped signposts. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, never oversized or dominating the image, and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Soft lime green (#ecf874) glows prominently among flowers and pastel gradients, with cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
